conventions.Hamiltonian_source: H_int=+J(t)V, radius r=r0/(1+J s), s from the same smooth profile
conventions.branch: principal local log branch near equal histories; zero overlap valid but log undefined
conventions.comparison: all fields; float atol2e-7 rtol2e-8; exact remaining types/keys/hashes
conventions.cutoff: finite spatial regulator; bare mean/equal-time noise are not renormalized sources
conventions.geometry: smooth R=2 AP axial cell, canonical H from the NSC9 covariant operator
conventions.influence: Z=det(I-C+C U_minus dagger U_plus), Gamma_IF=-i logZ
conventions.positive_frequency_FDT: N(omega)=-coth(beta omega/2) Im chi_R(omega); elastic zero-frequency part separately retained
conventions.probe: source impulses test functional derivatives; not finite delta-function geometries
conventions.pulse: interaction-picture unitary for stationary initial vacuum, window +/-7 width; smooth-history time refinement separate
conventions.retarded: chi_AB=-i theta(t-s) Tr C[A(t),B(s)], Fourier exp(+i omega t)
conventions.units: hbar=c=a=1; one representative kappa=1 channel unless explicitly stated

local_real_phase_control.mean_source_shift: alpha for F(J)=alpha J; illustrative, not selected physical coefficient
